visual_review.method: Inspected the actual 1000x1000 front, quarter and profile PNGs listed above.
observations: The lower crown and curved bill preserve the reviewed V2 cap direction.
Frontal fringe stems remain continuous from beneath the bill to their visible tips.
No large hair tufts protrude through the crown in these three views.
The helix cuffs and long metal drop remain visible in quarter/profile.
remaining_defects: Two tiny pale specks remain on the ear-side black band: quarter approximately (369,400) and (358,415), profile approximately (603,400) and (590,414). Their exact geometric cause is not established by these renders.
limitations: Sampled cap/head corridor clearance does not prove every hair triangle is free of cloth intersections.
This is a static Blender context review, not Unity appearance, animation, device performance or final artist-likeness approval.
